project.name: Information Diet System
project.description: Automatic information piping from external sources into AGI memory system - inspired by Letta tutorial

features.name: RSS Feed Ingestion
features.description: Fetch RSS feeds, extract content, summarize with LLM, store in memory

features.name: Research Paper Monitor
features.description: Watch arXiv/Semantic Scholar for AGI-relevant papers, auto-extract insights

features.name: YouTube Channel Monitor
features.description: Watch specified channels, auto-fetch transcripts, extract key concepts

features.name: n8n Webhook Integration
features.description: HTTP endpoint to receive data from n8n workflows and store in memory

features.name: Scheduled Consolidation
features.description: Cron-based memory consolidation - extract patterns, prune low-value content

features.name: Proactive Digest
features.description: Generate daily/weekly digests of gathered information, notify via voice/Arduino

workflow: 1. Pick next unimplemented feature (check dependencies first)
3. Run ALL test_steps manually or via automation
4. Only set 'implemented: true' after code is complete
5. Only set 'tested: true' after ALL test_steps pass
rules: NEVER mark implemented:true without complete code
NEVER mark tested:true without running test_steps
NEVER modify feature definitions after starting
ALWAYS update progress.md after each feature
